Welcome to my blog about the nerdy side of sailing. I will share my analysis of different sailing topics where I use simulation and data analysis to come up with interesting insights. Doing these deep dives are my way of studying a topic for my own improvement on the water. I just happen to love writing it down in a way that lets others share the pleasure of finding things out. There will also be posts about my personal experiences with sailing from regattas such as Silverrudder. I guess you can call it a mix of dry and wet sailing.
